blocks.text: Jism ke ghair makhsoos difa mein proteins ke do bare groups hissa lete hain.

Jigar ke banaye proteins complement system banate hain: darjan se zyada proteins jo khoon mein ghair fa'al haalat mein ghoomte hain. Jaraseem se milne par yeh tarteeb se fa'al hote hain, pehla doosre ko chalu karta waghaira. Aakhri paanch proteins jaraseem ki plasma membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain jo use chhed deta hai; mayi aur namak andar jate aur jaraseem phool kar phat jata hai.

blocks.alt: C1 se C5 tak paanch peele daire teeron se jure dikhate hain ke complement proteins tarteeb se aik doosre ko chalu karte hain. Teer jaraseem ki membrane tak jata hai jis mein peele proteins ka chhalla, membrane-attack complex, soorakh banata hai; neela teer dikhata hai ke mayi aur namak andar daurte hain.
blocks.caption: Complement ka silsila aur membrane-attack complex (Figure 21.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jigar ke banaye proteins complement system banate hain: darjan se zyada proteins jo khoon mein ghair fa'al haalat mein ghoomte hain. Jaraseem se milne par yeh tarteeb se fa'al hote hain, pehla doosre ko chalu karta waghaira. Aakhri paanch proteins jaraseem ki plasma membrane mein membrane-attack complex (MAC) banate hain jo use chhed deta hai, is liye mayi aur namak andar jate aur jaraseem phool kar phat jata hai.

blocks.text: Interferons virus zada cells ke chhore hifazati proteins hain. Yeh qareebi cells ko apna virus ke khilaf difa mazboot karne par aamada karte hain. Interferons cytokines ki bari jamaat se hain, aise proteins jo cells ke darmiyan rabte ke zariye immune system ke hifazati difa ko chalu karte hain, aur yeh natural killer cells aur macrophages jaise doosre immune cells ko bhi fa'al karte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf virus zarron wala virus zada cell chhote teal interferon molecules ki qatar chhorta hai. Teer saath wale cell tak jata hai jis ki satah par receptors hain, aur likha hai ke woh apne virus ke khilaf difa ko mazboot karta hai.
blocks.caption: Interferon saath wale cell ko khabardar karta hua (Figure 21.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Interferons virus zada cells ke chhore hifazati proteins hain. Yeh qareebi cells ko virus ke khilaf apna difa mazboot karne par aamada karte hain. Interferons cytokines ki bari jamaat se hain, aise proteins jo cells ke darmiyan paigham le ja kar immune system ke hifazati difa ko chalu karte hain, aur yeh natural killer cells aur macrophages jaise doosre immune cells ko bhi fa'al karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaun se hifazati proteins jaraseem par seedha asar karte hain aur kaun se doosre cells ko khabardar kar ke?
blocks.explanation: Complement proteins jaraseem mein soorakh kar ke seedha hamla karte hain; interferons doosre cells ko virus ke khilaf difa mazboot karwa kar kaam karte hain.

items: Complement: jigar ke proteins tarteeb se chalu; aakhri paanch MAC banate jo jaraseem phaarta.
Interferons: virus zada cells ke cytokines; parosiyon ko bachate, NK cells aur macrophages chalu karte.
